decision: No common carry-dominance variant improves both complete projection geometries. Keep it outside product dispatch and preserve the exact numerical primitive for future structural work. No inference or performance retention follows.
scope: Four-lane exact correction components using the unchanged lossless36-byte operand Row. A per-K16 bound comes from original scaling metadata, without added preprocessing. A dominating incoming carry avoids computing individual product exponents and their quad maximum. Supported branches share multiplication and normalization; all other groups retain original alignment or BF16 fallback. K16 order, signed modulo sum and candidate selectors stay unchanged. Generated cases compare all three raw Value words at every K16 endpoint against independent original wide CPU arithmetic, including tiny normals and large carries, with independent original-word path predicates and production/diagnostic agreement. Complete8192-row QKV and OUT capture shapes extend7169 original input rows and verify corresponding GB10 BF16 outputs, with no reference used as compute input. Full preparation is timed.
